title: Add classification labels and enforce egress denial (VC-201-073)
goal: VC-201-073 refuted: no classification label type exists — nothing propagates local-only/workspace-private/approved-cloud, so non-secret private content egresses; the env detector only matches *_API_KEY/_TOKEN/_SECRET names and values >=8 chars (DATABASE_PASSWORD and short tokens are missed); verbatim matching misses obfuscated secrets; default policy is Redact which ships scrubbed content rather than refusing; the scan is opt-in — egress paths that skip it are unchecked. Evidence: crates/susi-core/src/tests/vc_201_073_mastery.rs.
